items.why: Nvidia soars as the board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO, driving the Nasdaq rebound.
Volatility plunges as the Nasdaq roars back 6% and the S&P 500 rebounds 4% on the Nvidia news.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
Riding the AI rebound as Nvidia's surge on Huang's return lifts the whole sector.

market_note: S&P futures up about 4.6% and Nasdaq futures up about 6.7% as the AI rout pauses.
summary: Stocks are roaring back after a steep slide, led by Nvidia on Jensen Huang returning as CEO. The Nasdaq is up about 6% and the S&P 500 is rebounding about 4% as buyers step back in.
